study.question: Can an auxiliary-owned nonlinear history selector recover auxiliary quality lost by click-only selector-trunk training while retaining its click gain, and does auxiliary access to selector-input embeddings help or restore interference?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: g3-r0001-primary_feedback improves click AUC over g3-r0001-joint_feedback by 0.0021478336 (0.6576086162 vs 0.6554607825), but buy AUC drops by 0.0176343646 (0.8516566963 vs 0.8692910609), with worse auxiliary Logloss. The primary_item arm also improves click over joint_item, so the effect is not specific to feedback scoring. Hypothesis: depriving auxiliaries of nonlinear selector adaptation makes the click-owned trunk a poor auxiliary basis; one separately trainable auxiliary trunk can restore auxiliary selection without direct auxiliary gradients into the click trunk. Shared embeddings still learn through all task values/context/targets, so this does not claim complete task isolation or that auxiliary interference has been measured directly.

nearest_work.difference: STEM uses shared and task-specific embedding tables, experts and gated forward transfer with selected backward paths. Here embeddings remain shared, there are two history-score trunks (click versus pooled auxiliaries), and there is no cross-expert gate. Stop-gradient and task-specific representations are inherited ideas; no novelty claim.

Original INFNet uses categorical/sequence/task tokens, proxy cross-attention and gated within-type refinement. Its pinned benchmark uses task-mask sequence hubs. These variants instead retain one local-activation pooling stage and split nonlinear score ownership; no hub, broadcast or token stack is adopted. Paper and benchmark are distinct sources, not an equivalence claim.

Exact empirical parent: its auxiliary readout sees detached click-trained hidden features. The candidate replaces that auxiliary basis with an independently learning cloned trunk, with an input-gradient and a frozen-trunk control.

Retain target-conditioned local activation, concatenated field embeddings, action-valued histories and four prediction towers from the local adaptation. Split ownership is applied to the score trunk; this is not an exact original DIN reproduction.

inherited_components: Fixed data identity 9f110bfc2f037f36e2f48787b812df640fe5df2de1cda8db7ac04590c1c9be44, protocol hash, official_offline prefixes, labels, full-population validation, batch8192/history100/one epoch and fixed host seed20262027; raw data is not available in this coding phase and digests are inherited host-contract evidence rather than reverified here.

g3-r0001-primary_feedback field embedding tables, feedback-aware target/key/product/difference score inputs, padding mask before Dice and after scoring, unnormalized pooling, tied initial score rows and four independent Dice towers; no label-dependent forward inputs.
Sum of four unweighted BCE losses and frozen split optimizer/clipping/precision/loading policy; no training_loss hook or optimizer override.

Shared value/context/target embedding gradients for all tasks. A new auxiliary trunk is deep-copied only after the inherited reset and readout tying, preserving the inherited embedding/trunk/tower initialization and avoiding extra RNG draws in the three split variants.
study.proposed_difference: Implement four standalone variants. aux_detached (candidate.py) adds a cloned [64,32] auxiliary score trunk trained by cart/fav/buy from detached score-input interactions; click uses the inherited trunk. aux_live differs only by enabling auxiliary gradients into those interaction embeddings. aux_frozen has identical allocated parameters and initial forward functions but no auxiliary-trunk weight/alpha gradients, retaining label-free Dice running-statistic updates and trainable readout rows. wide_primary replaces the original shared [64,32] trunk with [128,32] while retaining primary-only shared-trunk gradients, placing nearly the same extra capacity in the click-owned shared selector instead of an auxiliary-owned trunk. All retain task-specific readout rows, masks, pooled values and prediction towers. The three auxiliaries still share their own trunk. For six item fields and d=16, a [64,32] trunk has 27,840 parameters; splitting adds 27,840 dense parameters, while widening adds 27,776 (64 fewer). This controls allocation approximately, not exactly or at equal measured compute.
predictions: Predeclared exploratory mechanism pattern: aux_detached exceeds parent buy AUC by at least 0.005 and auxiliary mean AUC by at least 0.002 while click AUC is no more than 0.0003 below parent. These absolute descriptive margins guide mechanism interpretation only; model selection remains highest full-validation click AUC. Report every task AUC/Logloss even if this pattern fails.

At identical cloned initialization and with trainable readout rows in both, aux_detached should outperform aux_frozen on auxiliary metrics if label-trained nonlinear auxiliary capacity matters. Outputs at initialization should agree for the three split variants, including training-mode BN behavior; their gradients should differ only on the declared paths.

aux_live versus aux_detached directly tests restoring auxiliary selector-input gradients. If aux_live loses click while improving auxiliary metrics, interference extends to the shared embedding score path; if it improves both, that path is complementary in this implementation. Neither outcome establishes gradient conflict without direct diagnostics.

If auxiliary-owned capacity is specifically useful, wide_primary should not reproduce the same auxiliary recovery with click retention despite nearly equal allocated dense capacity. Report actual parameters, allocated GPU/wall seconds, examples, peak memory, validation throughput and latency; matched data passes do not imply equal compute.

Report fixed host history slices with sample/positive/negative counts (negative=samples-positive), including empty histories. Empty rows must have exactly zero history pools. Slice metrics are exploratory; do not construct feedback-prevalence or frequency slices without authorized counts. Current evidence is single-seed and cannot establish significance.
falsifiers: If aux_detached does not improve auxiliaries relative to both g3-r0001-primary_feedback and aux_frozen, the proposed trainable-selector rescue is unsupported; one unsuccessful implementation does not refute all private task representations.

If auxiliary recovery consistently requires click deterioration larger than the predeclared descriptive margin, the desired tradeoff has not been resolved. A high auxiliary mean does not make it the click-selected model.

If wide_primary matches or exceeds the full recovery pattern at comparable measured cost, generic capacity/allocation remains a sufficient explanation and auxiliary trunk ownership is not established.

Any current-action or padding dependence, forbidden forward input, gradient-path violation, nonfinite probability/loss/gradient, or constructor/API failure invalidates that arm before interpreting performance. Retain failed costs; do not change the protocol to rescue it.
Evidence from existing same-seed functional repeats is reproducibility, not independent repeated mechanism support; neither nominal AUC deltas nor multiple histories constitute confidence intervals.
alternative_explanations: Extra active capacity, auxiliary feature starvation, different optimization geometry, or training-pass allocation can explain tradeoffs without measured gradient conflict.

Global dense gradient clipping can couple otherwise separate trunks, and shared embedding/value/context paths remain joint. Inference BN buffers are separate after cloning, so adaptation also changes their distributions; aux_frozen retains label-free BN updates but does not isolate every normalization interaction.

The wide control has different width-dependent initialization/conditioning and a 64-parameter mismatch; it is an approximate capacity replacement, not a pure ownership intervention. Split live/detached/frozen contrasts have exact allocation and initialization matching.

Cart/fav/buy share one auxiliary trunk, so residual conflicts among auxiliaries and sparse buy support may remain. A new four-task-private-selector study would require additional controls if this grouped implementation fails.

Round0 task_feedback versus task_item reversed the expected click benefit (-0.0004209770), while shared_feedback versus shared_item had a small positive delta (+0.0002638150). Round1 primary gradient routing reversed the feedback sign, yet lower auxiliary performance persisted. These nonwinning branches are retained; no industry method is confirmed by this lineage.

All nine allowed trials succeeded; no failed execution receipt is supplied and previous_runtime_error is null. The exact round1 joint repeats reproduce round0 values; they do not estimate seed variance. Agent-memory searches returned no records, so no unprovided memory or human-owned knowledge is assumed.

Released whole-window vocabularies/static snapshots and official_offline feedback maturity are inherited benchmark limitations. Auxiliary outcomes match user/category/brand within24h, not advertisement conversion; do not infer production causal validity.

cost_plan.stop_rule: This turn ends at the proposal/code handoff: do not install, train or launch agents. Local validation is syntax/AST/schema only because torch and data are unavailable. Host must perform constructor/forward/backward/finite-gradient checks, split-mode initialization equality, ownership gradient checks (including auxiliary row gradients), masking/padding/unknown-target-action invariance, empty histories and all-task output shapes before training, charging every check. variants.name: aux_detached
variants.note: Primary candidate: click-owned inherited trunk plus trainable cloned auxiliary trunk with detached interaction inputs. All auxiliary value/context/target paths remain jointly trained. Prospective, no new measured result.

variants.name: aux_live
variants.note: Single-change gradient contrast to aux_detached: auxiliary selector can update shared input embeddings; no direct auxiliary gradient into click selector trunk.

variants.name: aux_frozen
variants.note: Exact allocated-capacity/initialization control: cloned auxiliary trunk runs under no_grad, while BN buffers update label-free and auxiliary readout rows remain trainable. Measures learned adaptation beyond a fixed cloned basis; backward cost differs.

variants.name: wide_primary
variants.note: Approximate active capacity replacement: original primary-only shared-selector gradient routing with width [128,32]. About64 fewer parameters than split variants for six item fields; initialization and measured cost differ.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Reviewed prior declared use and executed task-score arms: round0 feedback-aware routing did not improve click; round1 trunk-gradient anchoring improved click with buy degradation. This does not establish INFNet effectiveness or knowledge-use causality. Original paper and pinned benchmark paths were checked separately this turn. A full hub replacement would obscure this specific auxiliary adaptation question.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: No new token, proxy or broadcast component adopted. Retain earlier task-specific score rows while testing two-group nonlinear selector ownership and controlled gradient boundaries.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: Local-activation score trunks with explicit backward ownership versus alternating proxy cross-attention and gated token refinement; not an INFNet reproduction.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: If learning-enabled auxiliary trunk does not improve over frozen and shared-capacity controls, do not credit task-aware information flow or external knowledge for the outcome.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Carry forward latest usage review: no local measurement isolates redundant downstream activations, and SSR was not executed in the supplied lineage. Do not convert prior consideration into a used mechanism or an audited original-paper claim.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: None; no sparsifier or multi-view fusion added.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: Current question concerns trainable nonlinear auxiliary history selection and backward ownership; SSR-style activation filtering is deferred. Original SSR source remains unaudited in this turn.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: Reconsider only after authorized activation diagnostics suggest a downstream redundancy mechanism and matched sparse/dense replacements can be budgeted.
